chapter.heading: A contemplation by David, when he was in the cave. A Prayer.
chapter.v:
I cry
with my voice to Yahweh.With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.

I pour
out my complaint before him.I tell him my troubles.

When my
spirit was overwhelmed within me,you knew my route.On the path in which I walk,they have hidden a snare for me.

Look on
my right, and see;for there is no one who is concerned for me.Refuge has fled from me.No one cares for my soul.

I cried
to you, Yahweh.I said, “You are my refuge,my portion in the land of the living.”

Listen to
my cry,for I am in desperate need.Deliver me from my persecutors,for they are too strong for me.

Bring my
soul out of prison,that I may give thanks to your name.The righteous will surround me,for you will be good to me.
